name: createAISession
description: Creates a session for talking to a configured AI endpoint. The session keeps the conversation history between calls.

params.name: name
params.description: The endpoint name from the Lucee Administrator, or a `default:category` reference.

params.name: systemMessage
params.description: Instructions that set the AI's role and rules for the whole session.

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of question and answer pairs to keep in the history. Older ones are dropped.

params.name: temperature
params.description: How random the responses are, from 0.0 (focused) to 1.0 (creative).
